name: Einstein’s molecular theory of Brownian motion
description: A molecular-kinetic prediction of observable suspended-particle motion.

events.statement: Einstein’s 1905 paper derived observable motion for small suspended particles from molecular-kinetic theory.

evidence.supports: The translated paper states the molecular prediction and notes initial uncertainty over identification with observed Brownian motion.
Dates submission to 11 May 1905 and labels the paper.

caveats: The paper did not itself establish atomic reality by a completed experimental confirmation; Brownian motion had been observed before Einstein’s theory. The linked translation was published later.
